==Usage==
Type {{Tlx|Inactive|date of last main namespace edit}}, for example, <nowiki>{{Inactive|January 1, 2022}}</nowiki> on the inactive user's page.

Per the [[Wookieepedia:User page and profile policy|'''User page and profile policy''']], users with no Wookieepedia [[w:c:community:Help:User contributions|editing contributions]] after twelve (12) consecutive months are considered inactive and may have their user page replaced with the {{Tl|Inactive}} template. All subpages of inactive users will be [[w:c:community:Help:Redirects|redirected]] to their main user page. Users are welcome to return their user page and subpages to active status at any time.
